blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.
blocks.zh: 长视距视频制作需要保留不断扩展的历史,但对其不断增长的标语序列的限定代价高昂. 现有方法限制或压缩历史背景,可能失去后代所需的信息。 这部作品提出ReCam,将本地历史潜伏的spatiental块组合成矢量,并直接将其投射到传播变形器的高维隐蔽空间中. 该模型通过本土自觉学习使用由此产生的内存符,减少符数,同时保留块级访问完整历史. 为了减轻在自转式推出过程中的时空漂移,我们进一步引入了双点除噪器,对近期上下文和目标框分别设置噪音表. 在被评价的方法中,ReCam在R2M-Bench上实现了最高的V Bench-Long总体得分80.1和竞争性的静态场景重现性能. 它还为屏幕外主体的重新出现确定了所有四个一致性指标,包括服装一致性为4.09,最佳基线为3.03。

These limitations motivate a method that allows video models to leverage the full history during autoregressive rollout directly.
Our key insight is that a coarse read does not require a coarse historical representation.
We reduce the historical token count by retrieving at a coarser granularity while retaining full-history coverage.
Each local spatiotemporal block of historical latents is flattened
into a vector and projected into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The resulting memory representations are learned jointly with the video model and processed through native self-attention. This allows local detail to be encoded within each memory token, giving the model access to every historical block through a shorter token sequence.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, effective use of history requires more than access: errors in generated frames can propagate to subsequent predictions ( Ning et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Agrawala, 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . To mitigate this drift, we introduce dual-pointer denoising, which assigns separate noise schedules to recent context frames and current target frames. At inference, context frames start from pure noise and follow a faster denoising trajectory, providing temporal cues while reducing the influence of errors in previously generated context.

blocks.en:
Building on these designs, we propose ReCam, which enables stable and consistent long-video generation.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Full-context memory. We introduce ReCam, a simple yet effective method that allows each token to encode a larger amount of spatiotemporal content, enabling end-to-end training for long-video generation and yielding a native long-term memory mechanism. • Dual-pointer denoising. We assign separate denoising trajectories to recent context frames and current target frames, providing temporal cues while masking prediction errors in the context frames. • Empirical evaluation. Extensive experiments on complementary benchmarks show that ReCam achieves the highest overall VBench-Long score among the evaluated methods ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , competitive performance on static-scene revisitation ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and the best results across all four metrics for off-screen subject reappearance ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . These results support the effectiveness of ReCam as a native long-term memory mechanism.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: ReCam combines a learned representation of accumulated video history with dual-pointer denoising of recent context. We first describe how historical latents are turned into memory tokens and accessed through native self-attention, then explain how recent context is incorporated during training and autoregressive rollout.
blocks.zh: ReCam将累积视频历史的博学表现与近期背景的双点代言相结合. 我们首先说明历史潜伏物是如何变成记忆符号的,并通过本土的自觉进入的,然后解释在培训和自动推出过程中最近的背景是如何融入的。

blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We initialize ReCam from the high-noise expert of Wan2.2-I2V-A14B and generate 480p videos at 16 fps, adding 40 pixel frames per autoregressive step. Training uses a global batch size of 64 and three stages of 10,000 steps, with maximum history lengths of 10, 20, and 30 seconds. We use AdamW with learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and 10 − 6 10^{-6} across the three stages. Default inference uses 40 Euler steps and classifier-free guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们从Wan2.2-I2V-A14B的高噪专家开始初始化ReCam,并在16英尺时生成480p的视频,每自动递归级阶增加40像素帧. 训练采用全球批量规模64,3个阶段10000步,最高历史长度10,20,30秒. 我们使用 AdamW 的学习率为 10 - 5 10 - 5 5 , 10 - 6 10 - 6 6 , 以及 10 - 6 10 - 6 6 。 默认推论使用40个欧拉步骤和无分级制导.

blocks.en: We train on an internal corpus of 2 million general-purpose videos lasting 5–60 seconds, mostly sourced from the web and covering diverse real-world scenarios. No manually constructed memory labels, such as revisit segments identified by FOV overlap, are used. For static-scene revisitation only, we additionally train on SpatialVID-HQ ( Wang et al., 2026a ) to acquire camera control. Appendix B provides further details.
blocks.zh: 我们用200万个通用录像进行内部培训,时间为5-60秒,主要来源于网络,涵盖各种现实世界情景。 没有使用手动构造的内存标签,如FOV重叠识别的复刻段. 仅为了静态场景重现,我们额外在SpaceVID-HQ(Wang等人,2026a)上进行训练,以获取相机控制. 附 录 B提供了进一步的细节。

blocks.en: We evaluate overall long-video quality and two forms of historical recall. The protocols and metric definitions are detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们评价整个长视频质量和两种历史召回形式。 议定书和计量定义详见附录C。

blocks.en: (1) Long-horizon generation. The official VBench-Long I2V suite ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluates 30-second videos at 480p across six dimensions of consistency, motion, and visual quality.
blocks.zh: (1)长视一代. 官方的V Bench-Long I2V套房(Huang et al., 2024)以480p评价30秒的视频,跨越了一致性,运动,视觉质量的六个维度.

blocks.en: (2) Static-scene revisitation. We use 100 reference scenes from R2M-Bench ( Gu et al., 2026 ) to test whether previously observed content is recovered when the camera returns. MemoryGain (MG) and the Normalized Memory Ratio (NMR) calibrate revisit consistency against controls from the same rollout across appearance fidelity, scene identity, and object identity.
blocks.zh: (2)静态场景再现. 我们使用来自R2M-Bench(Gu等人,2026年)的100个参考场景来测试之前观测到的内容是否在相机返回时被回收. MemoryGain(MG)和常态化的内存比(NMR)校正了对照同一推出的控件,在外观忠贞性,场景身份,以及物体身份上重温一致性.

blocks.en: (3) Off-screen subject reappearance. Following the MSVBench protocol ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate 64 histories covering 40 subjects and 10 backgrounds. Each history ends after the subject leaves the frame, and generation must recover that subject upon reappearance. In half of the histories, the subject first appears after the initial frame; in every history, it is absent for the final five seconds. We measure face, character, background, and clothes consistency against the reference history.
blocks.zh: (3)外屏主体再现. 根据MSV Bench协议(Shi等人,2026年),我们评价64个历史,涉及40个学科和10个背景。 每个历史在主体离开框架后结束,一代人必须在主体重新出现后恢复. 在一半的历史中,主题首先出现在初始框架之后;在每个历史中,最后5秒钟都不存在. 我们对照参考历史衡量面貌、性格、背景和衣服的一致性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 3.2 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en: All methods generate 30-second videos at 480p under the VBench-Long I2V protocol, except Helios, which uses its training resolution of 368p because performance degrades at other resolutions. In Tab. 1 , ReCam achieves the highest overall score of 80.1 among the evaluated methods, supporting its effectiveness across visual quality and long-term consistency.

blocks.en: Table 2 compares ReCam with raw historical KV-cache models (LingBot-World-Fast and LingBot-World-2-Fast ( Gao et al., 2026a ; Gao et al., 2026b ) ), FOV-based retrieval (HY-WorldPlay ( Sun et al., 2025 ) ), and recurrent state-space memory (Sana-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) ) under the same R2M-Bench protocol. Without an explicit geometry-based memory or manually constructed revisit supervision, ReCam remains competitive: it achieves the highest MG on MVPR-sim (0.212), ties for the highest MG on Sem.Persist (0.026), and obtains the highest NMR on SSIM (0.493).
blocks.zh: 表2将ReCam与原始的历史KV-cache模型(LingBot-World-Fast和LingBot-World-2-Fast)进行比较(Gao等人,2026a; Gao et al., 2026b ),基于FOV的检索(HY-WorldPlay(Sun et al., 2025)),以及同一R2M-Bench协议下的经常状态空间内存(Sana-WM(Zhu et al., 2026)). 没有明确的几何内存或人工构建的重访监管,ReCam仍然具有竞争力:在MVPR-sim上实现了最高的MG(0.212),在Sem.Persist上实现了最高的MG(0.026)的联系,在SSIM上获得了最高的NMR(0.493).

blocks.en: The remaining gap is most visible against HY-WorldPlay on NMR. We observe minor viewpoint and position shifts, motion instability, and occasional degradation on second or third revisits. Limited camera-control and revisit data may contribute to these failures. The results show that learned historical memory transfers to scene revisitation, while leaving room for improvement in camera accuracy and repeated-return consistency.
blocks.zh: 其余的差距在NMR上与HY-WorldPlay相比最为明显. 我们观察到一些小观点和位置的转变,运动不稳定,以及第二次或第三次重访时偶尔出现退化. 摄像头控制和重温数据有限可能助长这些故障。 结果显示,学到的历史记忆转移到场景重现,同时留有改进镜头准确性和重复回归一致性的空间.

blocks.en: We compare ReCam with six baselines using identical histories and reappearance targets (Tab. 3 ). FramePack supports only 19 context latents, corresponding to less than five seconds, so we use its official FramePack-F1 continuation strategy, which retains the first frame and a sliding window of recent frames.
blocks.zh: 我们利用相同的历史和重新出现的目标,将ReCam与六个基线进行比较(第3段)。 框架 Pack只支持19个上下文潜伏,对应于不到5秒,因此我们使用其官方的FramePack-F1延续策略,它保留了第一个帧和最近帧的滑动窗口.

blocks.en:
ReCam leads on all four metrics over the full evaluation set, including clothes
consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline. The split results reveal
where historical access matters most. When the subject is absent from the first
frame, ReCam leads on character, background, and clothes consistency, while
LingBot-World-Fast leads on face consistency. FramePack-F1 has a slight advantage on
face and character consistency when the subject is initially visible, but its face
distance increases from 0.400 to 0.745 when the subject is initially absent,
exceeding the 0.68 same-identity threshold for the VGG-face cosine distance we use.
In the initially absent cases, identity evidence lies outside both the first frame and the recent context. Full-history coverage keeps these intermediate observations available at generation time. The results therefore support retaining access to temporally distant subject information instead of relying only on fixed anchor frames or recent observations.

blocks.en: We compare clean context, single-pointer denoising (adding noise to context tokens), and dual-pointer denoising using changes in VBench metrics between the first and last two-second windows. blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Autoregressive video models support streaming ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , generative transmission ( Shao and Li, 2025 ; An et al., 2026 ) , and interactive applications ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) , but conditioning on generated history can propagate prediction errors. Prior work addresses this through more robust context conditioning, error-aware training, and planning. Noise perturbation uses scheduled noise levels for historical and newly generated frames to improve tolerance to imperfect context ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . Error-aware training instead simulates erroneous histories ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) or feeds model predictions back as context ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动回转的视频模型支持流线(袁等,2026年),基因传递(邵和李,2025年;安等,2026年),以及交互应用(杨等,2025年;陈等,2026年b),但是对生成历史的调节可以传播预测错误. 先前的工作通过更严格的环境条件、对错误的认识培训和规划来解决这一问题。 噪声扰动对历史和新产生的帧使用预定噪音水平,以提高对不完美背景的容忍度(Chen等人,2024年;Song等人,2025年)。 错误认识训练反而模拟错误历史(袁等人,2026年)或反馈模型预测作为上下文(黄等人,2025年;刘等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Planning methods generate farther-ahead frames or organize the rollout globally to limit the accumulation of local errors ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang and Agrawala, 2025 ) . Recent error-blocking work uses the same noise strength for historical and newly generated frames to restrict error propagation ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . Our dual-pointer design uses separate context and target noise schedules, together with paired context views that expose the denoising direction. The prediction objective remains focused on the current chunk.
blocks.zh: 规划方法产生更领先的帧或在全球组织推开,以限制局部误差的累积(Ma等人,2026年;张和阿格拉瓦拉,2025年)。 近期的阻断错误工作对历史和新产生的帧使用相同的噪音强度来限制错误传播(Zou等人,2026年)。 我们的双点设计采用了单独的上下文和目标噪声表,同时采用了对齐的上下文观点,暴露了调音方向. 预测目标仍然侧重于目前的块。

blocks.en: Long-term memory must balance the cost of reading history with the information retained for future generation. Keyframe- and view-based methods retrieve frame-level observations using temporal or spatial cues, including FOV overlap, camera pose, and surfel associations ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) . Explicit 3D memories, such as point clouds and depth-guided latent caches, preserve scene structure across viewpoints ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . These approaches organize historical access around selected observations or geometric structure.
blocks.zh: 长期记忆必须平衡阅读历史的成本与留给后代的信息. 基于关键框架和视图的方法利用时间或空间提示检索帧水平观测,包括FOV重叠,相机姿势,以及冲浪协会(Yu等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Xiao等人,2025年)。 明晰的3D记忆,如点云和深度导引潜伏缓存,保存了跨视角的场景结构(赵等人,2025;王等人,2026b). 这些方法围绕选定的观测或几何结构组织历史访问。

blocks.en: Other methods reduce the memory footprint through packed frame contexts, compact history embeddings, recurrent states, or learned query interfaces ( Zhang and Agrawala, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . Sparse attention reduces reading cost through chunk routing or token grouping ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . ReCam packs local spatiotemporal blocks into high-dimensional tokens and exposes all blocks to native self-attention. The block representations are learned jointly with video generation, combining full-history coverage with a shorter conditioning sequence.
blocks.zh: 其他方法通过打包框背景,紧凑历史嵌入,反复状态,或学习的查询接口来减少记忆足迹(张和阿格拉瓦拉,2025年;张等人,2025年;波等人,2025年;彭等人,2026年;余等人,2026年a). Sparse关注通过块路由或符号分组降低阅读成本(Cai等人,2026年;Jia等人,2026年). ReCam将本地的spatiotemporal块打包成高维度符号,并让所有块都暴露在本土的自我注意. 块式表示法与视频生成法共同学习,将全史报道与较短的调节序列相结合.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ReCam, which learns long-term video memory by packing local spatiotemporal history into high-dimensional tokens processed through native self-attention. This design reduces historical token count while preserving full-history coverage, allowing the video model to jointly learn how historical information is represented and used. Dual-pointer denoising complements this memory mechanism by assigning separate noise schedules to recent context and target frames to mitigate error propagation during autoregressive rollout. ReCam achieves the highest overall VBench-Long score of 80.1 among the evaluated methods and leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, while remaining competitive on scene revisitation. These results demonstrate that effective long-term memory can be learned from general-purpose video data.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReCam,通过将本地的spatiotoporal历史包装到通过本土自觉处理的高维符号中来学习长期视频记忆. 这种设计在保留完整历史覆盖的同时减少了历史符号计数,使得视频模型能够共同学习历史信息如何被表示和使用. 双点消音器对这个内存机制起到补充作用,为最近的上下文和目标框指定单独的噪声表,以减轻自递式推出过程中的错误传播. ReCam在被评价方法中实现了最高的整体V Bench-Long分数80.1,并领先于所有四个用于外屏主体重现的一致性度量,同时在现场重访时保持竞争力. 这些结果显示,可以从通用视频数据中吸取有效的长期记忆.

blocks.en: Reliable memory use in out-of-domain settings remains an open challenge. Future work will explore more demanding revisitation scenarios, diverse downstream applications, and learning from in-context demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 在域外环境中可靠使用内存仍然是一个公开的挑战。 今后的工作将探索更严格的重新审视方案、不同的下游应用以及学习内在文字演示。

We observe that small context noise shifts (0 and 0.1) expose a cleaner context
too early, which introduces prediction errors into more denoising steps and
degrades the temporal drift metric. This is consistent with our design hypothesis.
As the context noise shift increases, the generated videos become increasingly
static, as reflected by a lower dynamic degree (from 47.73 to 42.33).
This finding echoes Zou et al. [2026] : a noisier history may make it harder
for the model to determine the motion structure of newly generated frames in
early denoising steps, leading to static videos. A moderate shift, such as 1 or 2,
achieves the best trade-off between these two extremes, yielding the highest
VBench scores and the most favorable temporal drift metrics.
We therefore adopt s c = 2 s_{\mathrm{c}}=2 as the default setting in our experiments.
